title: Chemtrails
summary: Claims that condensation trails from aircraft are actually chemical or biological agents being deliberately sprayed for nefarious purposes.
introduction: The chemtrails conspiracy theory falsely claims that the condensation trails (contrails) left by aircraft are actually chemical or biological agents deliberately sprayed for purposes including weather modification, population control, or psychological manipulation. In reality, contrails are composed of water vapor and ice crystals formed when hot aircraft exhaust meets cold atmospheric air—the same phenomenon studied since the beginning of aviation. Multiple scientific surveys, including a landmark 2016 study of 77 atmospheric scientists, have found no evidence of secret spraying programs. The variation in contrail appearance and duration is fully explained by atmospheric conditions like humidity and temperature, not chemical content.
